title: 延長テーブルと架台付き自動かんな盤
description: 木工教室・共同工房の床に置く厚み仕上げ用の自動かんな盤。四脚架台、前後に実際に通り抜ける材料通路、主テーブルと延長テーブル、独立した刃胴カバー、送りローラー外装、四本の高さ支柱、上部手輪と後方の開口集塵口を造形。架台を含む一式1点で、木材や集塵ホースは含みません。切削・送り・高さ調整・排塵の動作や加工精度は実装・検証していません。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）0.706 × 1.467 × 1.236 m、16,420三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A thickness-finishing planer for floor placement in woodworking classrooms and shared workshops. It has a four-leg stand, truly open front-to-back stock passage, main bed and extension tables, distinct cutter-head cover, feed-roller exteriors, four height posts, top handwheel and open rear chip-extraction connection. Stand and machine are one assembly; lumber and extraction hose are absent. Cutting, feed, height adjustment, chip removal and machining accuracy are neither implemented nor validated. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 0.706 × 1.467 × 1.236 m; 16,420 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
